story_text:
## Your watch, now a health tracker.
Azume One is a 30 mm sensor disk that attaches to the back of the watch you already wear. No second device on your wrist, no screen, no notifications. Just a clear picture of your heart, your sleep, your recovery and your stress, in one app.
## You shouldn’t have to choose
You picked your watch for a reason. Maybe it was a gift. Maybe you saved for it. Maybe it just feels like you.
But if you want to understand your body, the market gives you two options: take your watch off and replace it with a smartwatch, or wear two devices at once. Most trackers also come with a screen that keeps lighting up, notifications that keep pulling you back to your phone, and a monthly subscription that never ends.
We thought there had to be a better way. So we built a tracker you never see.
Meet Azume One
Azume One sits between your watch and your skin. Its optical sensors track over 25 metrics around the clock, while a motion sensor follows every step and workout. Everything syncs to the Azume app over Bluetooth, where your data turns into scores, trends and insights you can actually use. From the outside, nothing changes. Your watch still looks like your watch.
## Invisible by design
No screen. No vibrations. No notifications. Azume One doesn’t compete for your attention, it just works in the background. You check in when you want to, not when a device tells you to.
At 2.8 mm and 5 g, you will forget it’s there. That’s the point.
## No glue. No magnets. Just nano-suction.
The side of Azume One that touches your watch is covered in microscopic suction cells. When you press it onto the caseback, the air is pushed out of each cell and a tiny vacuum forms. Together, they hold Azume One firmly in place, without any adhesive.
Because nothing sticks, nothing is left behind. Peel it off from the edge, air flows back in and it comes off clean, ready to go back on whenever you want.
How it works
- Attach. Press Azume One onto the caseback of your watch. Nano-suction holds it in place, no tools or glue needed.
- Wear. Go about your day as usual. At night, move the disk into the included FitBand for comfortable sleep tracking.
- Read. Open the Azume app and see your Recovery, Sleep and Stress scores.
## Product Showcase
## Your day at a glance
Recovery, Sleep and Stress turn your data into three simple scores, so you know in seconds how your body is doing. No charts to decode, no spreadsheets. Tap any score to see what’s behind it.
## Know what to do next
Numbers alone don’t change anything. That’s why Azume learns your personal baseline over the first two weeks. After that, it tells you when something changes, why it matters and what you can do about it.
A few examples of what Azume might tell you:
## Your Azume Age
How old do your habits make you? Azume Age turns your movement, fitness and sleep into one simple number: the age your lifestyle adds up to. Move more, sleep better, get fitter, and watch it go down.
Azume Age shows you exactly where those years come from, broken down into Movement, Fitness and Sleep. So you always know which small change will make the biggest difference.
It updates once a week, so a single bad night won’t throw it off. What counts is what you do consistently.
Azume Age is a wellness score based on your lifestyle habits. It is not a medical measurement of biological age.
## Stress
Stress isn’t just a feeling. Your heart shows it long before you notice it yourself, and Azume One picks it up day and night from your heart rate and heart rate variability.
The app plots your stress across the whole day, night included. Tap the graph to see any hour, and spot the meetings, the commute or the late coffee that pushed it up. Your workouts are marked right in the graph, so a hard run never gets mistaken for a hard day.
At the end of the day, you see how much time you spent in low, moderate and high stress, and how well your body recovered overnight. When your stress runs higher than usual, Azume lets you know and suggests a small way to bring it back down.
## Made for movement
Every session lands in the app with your full heart rate curve, duration, calories, distance and pace, so you can see exactly how hard you pushed. From strength training to tennis, from your morning run to a long hike.
## Start any of these workouts in the app
Walking, Running, Cycling, Hiking, Mountaineering, Rock climbing, Jump rope, Basketball, Football, Badminton, Table tennis, Tennis, Volleyball, Golf, Gym, Strength training, Yoga, Sit-ups, Jumping, Stepper, Rowing, Elliptical, Aerobics, Dance, Roller skating, Kayaking.
## Every step counts
Azume One counts your steps, distance and calories all day, from your morning commute to your evening walk. Active and total calories show you how much energy you really burn.
## Set a goal. Watch it happen.
Set your own step and calorie goals and see your progress at a glance. Hit them day after day and build a streak that keeps you moving.
## FitBand. Day and night.
Not every moment is made for your watch. For sleep, and for sports where you would rather leave your watch at home, Azume One moves into the FitBand: a soft, woven nylon band with a holder shaped like a watch case. Azume One sits right in the middle, with its sensors facing your skin.
It’s light, breathable and comfortable enough to forget you’re wearing it, whether you’re asleep or on the court. The metal bars that hold the band together are fully enclosed, so nothing metal touches your skin. And because the FitBand itself has no electronics, there is nothing to charge.
The FitBand is included with every Azume One.
## Built for the night
At night, simply move Azume One from your watch to the included FitBand, so you never have to sleep with your watch on. Of course, you still can if you want to.
While you sleep, Azume One tracks how long you spend in light, deep and REM sleep, along with your nightly heart rate, your HRV and how well your body recovers.
In the morning, you wake up to your Sleep score and a clear picture of your night: when you fell asleep, how long you spent in each stage, how often you woke up and how much sleep you actually need. Over time, Azume learns what a good night looks like for you and shows you how last night compares to your baseline.
## Community features
Staying active is easier with friends. Add the people you want with your personal friend code and see who moved the most today on a simple leaderboard.
Join challenges together, follow your friends’ achievements in the feed and keep track of your own progress in your profile. Every step, every goal and every streak counts, for you and for the people who motivate you.
You decide who you connect with. Only people you add as friends can see your activity.
## Your data. Your rules.
Your health data is personal, and we treat it that way. Everything Azume One measures is stored on servers in the EU, in Ireland, and protected by GDPR. Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and the Azume app contains no ad trackers and no third-party analytics.
We only collect health data after you have given your consent. You decide whether Azume shares your data with Apple Health, and you can switch it off at any time. If you do, the data Azume wrote there is removed again.
You can export all your data or permanently delete your account at any time, directly in the app. Deleted data is also removed from our backups within about a week.
## What Azume One measures
More than 40 metrics, each one measured against your personal baseline. Azume learns what’s normal for you, so every number tells you something.
## Heart
- Heart rate, day and night
- Resting heart rate
- Heart rate variability (HRV)
- Nightly HRV
- Blood oxygen (SpO2)
- VO2 max
- Respiratory rate
## Sleep
- Total sleep time
- Sleep stages: light, deep, REM and awake
- Restorative sleep: your deep and REM sleep combined
- Sleep efficiency
- Bedtime and wake-up time
- Sleep need
- Sleep debt
- Sleep vs. need
- Sleep heart rate
- Sleep stress
- Sleep score
## Recovery
- Daily Recovery score
- Overnight stress recovery
- Personal insights that tell you what changed, why it matters and what to do about it today
## Stress
- All-day stress curve
- Time in low, moderate and high stress
- Daily stress score
## Activity and energy
- Steps
- Distance
- Active calories
- Resting calories
- Total calories burned
- Step and calorie goals
- Streaks
## Body
- Skin temperature
## Every workout
- Duration, distance, steps and calories
- Heart rate curve and intensity
- Average, maximum and minimum heart rate
## Timeline
risks: Most of the hard steps are already behind us: the Azume app is live on the App Store and Google Play, and production tooling for Azume One is complete. The funds we raise here go into one thing: our first production run. There are still risks we want to be open about: Certification: Azume One is currently going through CE and FCC testing. If a test requires changes, shipping could be delayed by a few weeks. Production: Hardware production can be delayed, for example when components arrive later than planned. We have built buffer into our timeline and will let you know early if anything changes. Shipping and customs: International deliveries, especially to the US, can take longer due to customs processing. We will post an update every week, so you always know where we stand. If something goes wrong, you will hear it from us first. Health and Wellness Product Disclaimer: This project and its rewards are not a replacement for medication, medical treatment, or a doctor’s examination. Kickstarter does not endorse or verify the veracity of any claims made on project pages, and is not responsible for any opinion, advice, information, or statements made by third parties, including creators. Projects on Kickstarter do not claim to diagnose, treat, or cure any medical condition. The Creator is solely responsible for complying with industry standards and applicable laws, including product safety standards.

faq.q: Does Azume One work with my watch?
faq.a: Azume One attaches to the caseback of most watches using nano-suction, no tools or glue needed. With a diameter of just 30 mm, it fits behind most watches with a flat, smooth caseback of similar size or larger.
No. You pay once and get every feature of the Azume app. There is no monthly fee and no locked features.
Place Azume One on the included charging dock. You can even leave it attached to your watch. The dock connects to power via the included USB-C cable.
Azume One is water-resistant for everyday situations like hand washing or rain. It is not suitable for swimming or showering. (IP68)
On servers in the EU. The Azume app has no ad trackers and no third-party analytics. You can export all your data or permanently delete your account at any time, directly in the app.

faq.q: What will the funds be used for?
faq.a: Development of Azume One and the app is complete. All funds raised on Kickstarter go into our first production run.

faq.q: Should I wear it while sleeping?
faq.a: Yes. Sleep tracking and your morning Recovery score depend on wearing Azume One overnight. If you don't want to sleep with your watch on, simply switch the disk to the included FitBand before bed for maximum comfort.

faq.q: Does Azume work with Apple Health and Health Connect?
faq.a: Yes. Sharing is optional: you turn it on in the app settings and choose which data types to share. If you switch it off later, the data Azume wrote to Apple Health is removed again.
